ticket.title: outfeed plan: -d is the suite dir and the clean check reports an unnamed dirty file at the wrong root
ticket.description:
Two traps found while planning the GB-361/GB-362 release, both costing a wrong first answer.

(1) `outfeed plan -d miter` does not plan miter. -d is the SUITE directory, exactly as it already is for `outfeed install` (which I hit earlier the same way), and the repository is the positional argument. The wrong form fails with `Manifest error in ./Cargo.toml: No such file or directory`, which reads as a broken checkout rather than as a misuse of the flag. The correct form is `outfeed plan miter -d /path/to/suite`.

(2) The clean-working-tree check runs at the harness root, not at the repository being released. With one unrelated modified file in the suite root (an editor rewriting gaugeblock.code-workspace), every member plan refuses with "working tree has uncommitted changes" while `git -C miter status --porcelain` is empty. Reproduced by restoring that file: plans then run. Whether the harness should gate a member release is a question, but the failure told me nothing about where to look - the error names neither the directory checked nor the file at fault.

Wanted: -d documented as the suite directory in `plan --help` (or renamed), and the dirty-tree error naming the repository it actually inspected plus one offending path. Cheap, and both would have saved the twenty minutes this took.
REPRODUCED FROM A FOREIGN REPO 2026-11-13, while cutting aerofoil 0.1.0-beta.2 in
/Users/wolff/dev2026/aerofoil - a single Cargo workspace with no suite layout at all:

  outfeed plan -d . --no-llm

  [outfeed] Release Plan for 'crate'
  Current Version:  0.1.0-beta.1
  Target Version:   0.1.0-beta.2 (PreReleasePatch)
  Unreleased Commits: 119
  Shipped Tickets:  GB-362, SP-54
  Modified Files:   8
  Proposed CHANGELOG.md Section:
  ## [v0.1.0-beta.2] - 2026-11-13
  ### Added
  - storypole: give an unscoped ticket the configured gate, not the fallback
  - web: 60 FPS kinematic dead-reckoning and frame-synced jumpTo ChaseCamera
  ...

Three distinct failures in one invocation, none of which errored:
  * the repository is named 'crate', not 'aerofoil';
  * the shipped tickets are GB-362 and SP-54, which are the suite's tickets and not the
    repository being planned;
  * the proposed section mixes the suite's commits (storypole) with the caller's (web), so the
    changelog it would write is a blend of two repositories.

Because the caller receives a confident plan instead of an error, this failure mode is worse than the
"Manifest error" form in (1): a person who trusts the output commits a changelog about someone else's
work. The release was done by hand instead, which is the work the tool existed to avoid.

One more detail for the version bump: it proposes a "## [v0.1.0-beta.2]" heading, while the caller's
CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog and writes "## [0.1.0-beta.2]" with no v. A tool that writes a
heading should match the file it is writing into, or refuse and say why.
